display.title: Display settings
levels.c00-l01.brief: Press i to start typing. Then type the missing letter: a capital I.
levels.c00-l01.hint1: Vim starts in NORMAL mode, where letters are commands. The i command switches to INSERT mode.
levels.c00-l01.title: Insert mode
levels.c00-l02.brief: The l key (lowercase L) moves the cursor one step right. Move once, press i, type e.
levels.c00-l02.hint1: i inserts text just before the cursor. The cursor must be on the first l of Hllo.
levels.c00-l02.hint2: Press l, then i, then e.
levels.c00-l02.title: Move right
levels.c00-l03.brief: Esc leaves INSERT mode. In NORMAL mode, j moves down one line. Add the first letter of both lines.
levels.c00-l03.hint1: After you type B, press Esc. Without Esc, the j key types the letter j.
levels.c00-l03.hint2: Press i, B, Esc, j, i, L.
levels.c00-l03.title: Back to normal mode
levels.c00-l04.brief: h moves left, j down, k up, l right. Add the two missing letters: y in the first line, o in the last.
levels.c00-l04.hint1: For the first line: k, h, then i and y, then Esc.
levels.c00-l04.hint2: For the last line: j, j, l, l, then i and o.
levels.c00-l04.title: Four directions
levels.c00-l05.brief: Add the missing o, press Esc, then type :wq and press Enter. This saves the file and quits.
levels.c00-l05.hint1: Commands that start with : only work in NORMAL mode. Press Esc first.
levels.c00-l05.hint2: :w saves, :q quits, :wq does both, :q! quits without saving. Here: i, o, Esc, then :wq and Enter.
levels.c00-l05.title: Save and quit
levels.c01-l01.brief: x deletes the character under the cursor. No INSERT mode needed. Delete the two extra letters.
levels.c01-l01.hint1: Move with h, j, k, l until the cursor is on the extra letter, then press x.
levels.c01-l01.hint2: Press l, x, j, l, x.
levels.c01-l01.title: Delete a character
levels.c01-l02.brief: dd deletes the whole line under the cursor: press d two times. Delete the virus line.
levels.c01-l02.hint1: The cursor can be anywhere on the line.
levels.c01-l02.title: Delete a line
levels.c01-l03.brief: a starts typing just after the cursor. A (capital) starts typing at the end of the line. Fix both lines.
levels.c01-l03.hint1: First line: press a, type o, press Esc.
levels.c01-l03.hint2: Second line: press j, then Shift+A, then Space and 0.
levels.c01-l03.title: Append
levels.c01-l04.brief: I (capital i) starts typing before the first character of the line, from anywhere. Add the word let.
levels.c01-l04.hint1: I does not go to column 0: it stops before the first character that is not a space.
levels.c01-l04.hint2: Press Shift+I, then type let and a Space.
levels.c01-l04.title: Insert at the line start
levels.c01-l05.brief: o opens a new line below and starts typing. O (capital) opens one above. Add both lines.
levels.c01-l05.hint1: Press Shift+O, type ready, press Esc.
levels.c01-l05.hint2: Then press j to go back to the set line, press o, type go.
levels.c01-l05.title: Open a line
levels.c01-l06.brief: u undoes the last change. Ctrl+R does it again. Try it: press d, d (wrong line!), press u, then delete the right line.
levels.c01-l06.hint1: u works in NORMAL mode. Press it several times to go further back.
levels.c01-l06.title: Undo
levels.c02-l01.brief: w jumps to the start of the next word, b to the start of the previous one, e to the end of a word. Delete the two extra letters.
levels.c02-l01.hint1: The cursor starts at the end of the line. Press b, b to reach thenn, then e to reach its last letter.
levels.c02-l01.hint2: Press b, b, e, x, then b, b, x.
levels.c02-l01.title: Word by word
levels.c02-l02.brief: $ jumps to the end of the line, 0 to column zero, ^ to the first character that is not a space. Delete the three extra characters.
levels.c02-l02.hint1: First line: $ then x, then ^ then x.
levels.c02-l02.hint2: Second line: press j, then 0, then x.
levels.c02-l02.title: Line ends
levels.c02-l03.brief: W, B and E (capitals) move like w, b and e, but only spaces separate words: dots and signs do not stop them. Delete the ; and the x.
levels.c02-l03.hint1: Shift+E jumps to the end of the first block: the ; sign.
levels.c02-l03.title: Big words
levels.c02-l04.brief: A number before a command repeats it: 4w moves four words, 3x deletes three characters, 3dd deletes three lines.
levels.c02-l04.hint1: Press 4, w to land on the first #. Then 3, x.
levels.c02-l04.hint2: Then press j and 3, d, d.
levels.c02-l04.title: Counts
levels.c03-l01.brief: d is an operator: it deletes what the next motion covers. dw deletes to the start of the next word. Delete one the.
levels.c03-l01.hint1: Put the cursor on the first letter of a the, with w.
levels.c03-l01.title: Delete a word
levels.c03-l02.brief: d$ deletes from the cursor to the end of the line. D (capital) is the short form. Delete everything after red, the space too.
levels.c03-l02.hint1: The cursor must be on the space after red.
levels.c03-l02.hint2: Press Shift+W, e, l, then Shift+D.
levels.c03-l02.title: Delete to the line end
levels.c03-l03.brief: c works like d, then switches to INSERT mode. cw replaces a word. Change slow to fast.
levels.c03-l03.hint1: Go to the word slow with 3, w.
levels.c03-l03.hint2: Press c, w, then type fast.
levels.c03-l03.title: Change a word
levels.c03-l04.brief: yy copies a line. p pastes below the cursor, P (capital) above. dd also copies the line it deletes. Copy the first line, then move save below play.
levels.c03-l04.hint1: Press y, y, then p: the first line is now there two times.
levels.c03-l04.hint2: Press j to reach save, then d, d and p.
levels.c03-l04.title: Copy and paste
levels.c03-l05.brief: The dot key repeats the last change. Delete the first TODO with dw, then repeat it on the other lines.
levels.c03-l05.hint1: After d, w, press j to go down, then the dot key.
levels.c03-l05.hint2: Press d, w, j, dot, j, dot.
levels.c03-l05.title: Repeat
